text: Slc23a1, mouse ortholog of rat ascorbic-acid transporter Svct2, is essential for vitamin C transport. Homozygous Slc23a1−/− fibroblasts showed <5% normal ascorbic-acid uptake; blood and tissue levels were undetectable or markedly reduced. Prenatal supplementation did not raise fetal blood ascorbic acid, implicating Slc23a1 in placental transport. Mutants died minutes after birth from respiratory failure and intraparenchymal brain hemorrhage; lungs lacked postnatal expansion despite normal surfactant protein B, and skin 4-hydroxyproline was normal. Separately, in asthma, CX3CR1 deficiency or blockade reduced allergic lung disease; CX3CR1 signaling promoted T(H)2 survival in inflamed lungs, and BCl-2-transduced CX3CR1-deficient T(H)2 cells restored asthma. CD200R/CD200 inhibits human osteoclastogenesis, revealing a new mechanism of osteoclast control by mesenchymal stem cells.
